note:
Stage 1o neutral-intensity candidates (2026-11-03, before any Stage 1o registration). In Stage 1n both gated models
(OLMo, Tulu) failed the neutral check: the Stage 1m neu_hi sentences ("It was enormous.", "temperature soaring") were
rated as more emotional than neu_lo by more than half the anger_L - anger_lo difference. Three candidate sets with
less affective wording are probed (closing sentences rated alone, no steering; s1o_neu_probe.py):
  numA  numeric magnitude, same sentence with a ten times larger number
  meaB  measurement register (a reading near the top vs the middle of its range)
  plnC  plain degree words without exclamatory intensifiers ("very" vs no modifier)
Each pair has the same word count. Writes stage1o_neu_closings.json.
